cohort: The study cohort consisted of women undergoing a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) between May 2007 and April 2016.
finding: Maternal body mass index (BMI) did not have a significant effect on the success rates of trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC).
mod_finding: Maternal body mass index did not significantly impact the success of a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC).
